notes.subject: Izebele go Yehu
notes.rationale: Sebopego sa go bitša ka tlhwaafalo — Izebele o bitša Yehu ka leina la Zimri.

notes.subject: A khotšo, Zimri
notes.rationale: Diphetolelo di fapana: kupišo ya kgotlelo ('go na le khotšo?') kgahlanong le tsela ya go tehetsa — go mo bitša 'Zimri' ke go mo tšhohetša bjalo ka mogaudi wa kgoši yo a bolaileng mong wa gagwe.

notes.subject: Zimri
notes.rationale: Go šumiša leina la Zimri (1 Bar. 16) ke tsela ya go swantšha; se sengwe se lahlegile ge lentšu le fetolelwa fela bjalo ka leina.

translation: Gomme Yehu a tsena ka kgoro, gomme a re: A khotšo, Zimri, yo bolaileng mong wa gagwe?
